# shadow/no-unkeyed-dynamic-list

Prefer `<For>` over `.map()` for lists rendered in JSX.

`recommended` `has suggestions`

## Why

`{items().map(...)}` re-runs the callback for every item whenever the list changes: all rows are rebuilt, DOM state (focus, scroll, input text) is lost and the cost grows with the list. `<For>` keeps a row per item (or per key) and only creates, moves or removes the rows that changed.

## Incorrect

```tsx
const [todos] = useSignal([]);
const list = <ul>{todos().map((todo) => <li>{todo.title}</li>)}</ul>;
```

```tsx
const [rows] = useSignal([]);
const list = <ul>{rows().map((row) => <li key={row.id}>{row.name}</li>)}</ul>;
```

## Correct

```tsx
const [todos] = useSignal([]);
const list = <ul><For each={todos()}>{(todo) => <li>{todo.title}</li>}</For></ul>;
```

```tsx
const [rows] = useSignal([]);
const list = <ul><For each={rows()} key={(row) => row.id}>{(row) => <li>{row().name}</li>}</For></ul>;
```

```tsx
<ul>{[1, 2, 3].map((n) => <li>{n}</li>)}</ul>
```

## Options

```json
[
  {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "reactiveOnly": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false
  }
]
```

Defaults: `[{"reactiveOnly":true}]`

## Suggestions

A suggestion (not an autofix) rewrites `{list.map(callback)}` to `<For each={list}>{callback}</For>` and adds the `For` import. The index becomes an accessor (`i()`); a `key` attribute on the row root becomes the `key` function and the item becomes an accessor (`row()`). It is withheld for non-arrow callbacks, optional chains, destructured or reassigned parameters, more than two parameters, a body that is not a single JSX element, a `key` that uses the index, or a comment outside the callback that the rewrite would delete.

## Disabling

Disable one line with `// eslint-disable-next-line shadow/no-unkeyed-dynamic-list`, a block with `/* eslint-disable shadow/no-unkeyed-dynamic-list */` and `/* eslint-enable shadow/no-unkeyed-dynamic-list */`, or a whole file with the block form at its top. When rebuilding every row is intended, for example a short list whose rows hold no state and are always replaced together.

## Notes

- Lists of fixed, literal size (`[a, b].map`, `Array.from({ length: 3 }).map`) are not reported.
- By default only lists that can change are reported: the receiver must read an accessor, a store, the component's props, or a constant derived from them. `GROUPS.map(...)` over a module constant is fine. Set `reactiveOnly: false` to report every `.map` that renders JSX.
- A `key` attribute on the row root becomes the `key` function of `<For>`; the item is then an accessor and the suggestion rewrites `row` to `row()`.

## Messages

- `useFor`: `.map()` in JSX rebuilds every row when the list changes and drops row state. Use `<For each={...}>`.
- `convertToFor`: Convert to `<For>`.
